::: {.obsidian-procedure-document}
:::

State the purpose of the procedure in one paragraph. Name the
outcome the procedure delivers.

# Before you start

List the prerequisites. Name the approvals, the systems, and the
inputs required before the first step.

# Procedure

Give the steps in order. Write each step as one instruction.

1.  Raise the requisition in the system.
2.  Get the budget holder approval.
3.  Issue the request for quotation.
4.  Evaluate the responses.
5.  Award the order.
6.  Record the order in the register.

# Records

Name the records the procedure creates and the place the
organisation keeps them.

# Review

State the review cycle and the owner of the next review.
